bikeRamps.hook: Build Bike Ramps for Rancho Cucamonga
bikeRamps.summary: Axel's Eagle Scout project is bringing free public bike ramps to Rancho Cucamonga — a safe place for local kids to ride, built by the community.
bikeRamps.story: Led by Scout Axel with support from Active Inland Empire, this project turns donated lumber and volunteer weekends into ramps every rider can use — free, forever. Your donation buys materials and safety gear, and you can tell the city what you want in the bike park through the public comment board below.
bikeRamps.shareText: Help build free public bike ramps in Rancho Cucamonga with Active Inland Empire!

generalFund.summary: The General Fund covers permits, equipment, ice, and insurance so our health and wellness events stay free or low-cost for everyone.
generalFund.story: Every month we allocate contributions across our programs — community rides, contrast therapy pop-ups, and new “third place” experiments. Contributors can opt into impact updates, so you see exactly what your support made happen.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.content: All Active Inland Empire events will have photos and videos taken during participation. Active Inland Empire reserves the right to reuse and distribute material in our marketing, grant reporting, and social media channels. Request for removal can be sent to organization@activeie.org. Surveys and content written by willing participants will remain confidential and will abide by California privacy laws. No information provided through such surveys will be retained long-term by Active Inland Empire. You will only be reached out to by event and support profiles directly from the organization.

contrastTherapy.subtitle: Contrast Therapy Services — Mobile Cold Plunge & Recovery
contrastTherapy.metaLine: Pricing Sheet • Effective June 2026 • Prices valid 30 days from quote
contrastTherapy.intro: Mobile contrast therapy — cold plunge and recovery setups delivered, set up, and operated at your location. Every package includes equipment, generator power, fuel, and ice. Choose on-site water (we pump from your source) or let us bring the water to you.
contrastTherapy.customNoteBody: beyond 400 gallons, add $200 per additional 400-gallon increment. Large volumes include us bringing the water.
contrastTherapy.includes1: Delivery, setup & breakdown at your location
contrastTherapy.includes2: Cold plunge / contrast therapy equipment rental
contrastTherapy.includes3: On-site generator power for the full event
contrastTherapy.includes5: Ice & ice delivery, sized to your plunge volume
contrastTherapy.includes6: On-site operation & water management during the event
contrastTherapy.waterBringMeaning: No usable water at the venue. We haul water in by truck and trailer and fill on arrival.
contrastTherapy.depositTerms: A 50% deposit of the total reserves your date; the balance is due the day of the event before setup. Deposits are refundable up to 7 days out, then may be applied to a rescheduled date.
contrastTherapy.finePrint: Mileage beyond the local service area may add $0.29/mile.
